method.warmup: one index construction and drop before measurement per process
method.samples: 7 paired samples per workload; alternating before/after; serial
method.heap: successful requested allocation/reallocation bytes; retained and peak deltas relative to live caller setup; excludes post-measurement API output characterization; not RSS or allocator usable bytes
method.timing: Instant around one index construction, allocation meter enabled; no CI time threshold
method.timeout: 30,000 ordinary bindings + 30,000 aliases, CLI 10ms deadline; not a deterministic timing assertion
